summary.text: Ron Dunn is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 16 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a pharmacy retail store manager and certified pharmacy technician.

paragraphs.text: Ron Dunn lives in Londonderry, New Hampshire, and earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of New Hampshire.
His career experience includes work as a pharmaceutical retail store manager and a certified pharmacy technician, and he is a member of the National Rifle Association.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2022, and he was assigned to the Resources, Recreation and Development Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
